endorsements.name: Staffan Truvé
endorsements.label: Threats of Tomorrow: Using Artificial Intelligence to Predict Malicious Infrastructure Activity
endorsements.description: The ever-increasing scale and complexity of cyber threats is bringing us to a point where human threat analysts are approaching the limit of what they can handle. We believe the next-generation of cyber threats must be tackled by a combination of machines equipped with artificial intelligence (AI) and human analysts. A new approach to forecasting malicious IP infrastructure by using machine learning.
endorsements.subtitle: Insomni'hack 2018
